what_we_could_not_tell_you.claim: No active federal shortage-area designations exist in Fulton County: 0 active designations and 99 geographic designations with status 'Proposed For Withdrawal' in shortage_areas (no signal, not 'no problem').

I can tell you about the region, not this street: PM2.5 air quality varies only 1.05x across Fulton County (8.98 to 9.81 ug/m3) on a 12 km EPA grid model wearing tract IDs; it cannot rank neighborhood tracts.

I can tell you about the region, not this street: Respiratory emergency department trends (COVID, flu, RSV) are reported for a 4-county Health Service Area (Clayton, DeKalb, Fulton, Gwinnett) and cannot differentiate neighborhoods.

Adult safety-net access gap: 41% to 60% of Fulton tracts (135 to 194 of 326) are farther from adult safety-net care than from any care (worst distance 28.6 to 39.8 km). School clinics were excluded from distances because they may serve students only.
Clinic operating hours: 5 of 30 health center sites open < 20 hours/week (minimum 4 h); 47 of 51 safety-net records report 0 weekly hours in HRSA data, and 0 report Saturday hours.
Distances are straight-line centroid upper bounds to federally recognized sites only—not street driving or MARTA transit times; informal or non-federal care may be closer.

High-need trade-off surfaced to human outreach lead: Tract 13121011431 (34.6% uninsured, ~75% Hispanic) is in no passing 4-stop plan because including it pushes other groups below the 0.8 equity threshold. Recommended for dedicated Saturday deployment next month with Spanish navigators.

who_this_plan_lands_on.finding: Plan passes the equity audit across all groups without flags (Black 1.02, Hispanic 1.02, White 0.88, Asian 1.04 >= 0.80 benchmark). Total estimated uninsured served: ~2,094.
who_this_plan_lands_on.structural_hypothesis: Race and ethnicity were strictly firewalled out of the Planner's inputs and scoring formula. Any demographic difference reflects structural co-variation between adult uninsurance, zero-vehicle household prevalence, and distance to adult safety-net care across Fulton County.

outreach.flyer_en:
Free Mobile Health Van in Fulton County!
We are here to help you stay healthy. You do not need health insurance. You do not need an ID or any money. All care is 100% free.

Saturday Dates and Stops:
- Saturday 1: Tract 13121011431 (Southwest Atlanta)
- Saturday 2: Tract 13121010214 (Bankhead / West Fulton)
- Saturday 3: Tract 13121007710 (Oakland City / Sylvan Hills)
- Saturday 4: Tract 13121011647 (South Fulton / College Park)

Free Services Offered:
- Fast blood pressure checks
- Blood sugar and diabetes screenings
- Free doctor checkups for the whole family
- Help finding a free health clinic near your home

Walk in any time from 9 AM to 3 PM. Everyone is welcome!
outreach.flyer_es:
¡Unidad Móvil de Salud Gratuita en el Condado de Fulton!
Estamos aquí para ayudarle a cuidar su salud. No necesita seguro médico. No necesita identificación ni dinero. Toda la atención es 100% gratuita.

Fechas y Lugares de los Sábados:
- Sábado 1: Sector 13121011431 (Suroeste de Atlanta)
- Sábado 2: Sector 13121010214 (Bankhead / Fulton Oeste)
- Sábado 3: Sector 13121007710 (Oakland City / Sylvan Hills)
- Sábado 4: Sector 13121011647 (Fulton Sur / College Park)

Servicios Gratuitos:
- Chequeos rápidos de presión arterial
- Pruebas de azúcar en sangre y diabetes
- Consultas médicas gratuitas para toda la familia
- Ayuda para encontrar clínicas comunitarias cerca de su hogar

Atención sin cita previa de 9 AM a 3 PM. ¡Todos son bienvenidos!
outreach.sms_en: Free Health Van in Fulton Co this Saturday 9am-3pm! Free checkups and diabetes care. No insurance or ID needed. Walk in anytime!
outreach.sms_es: ¡Unidad de Salud gratis en Fulton este sábado 9am-3pm! Chequeos y pruebas gratis. No se necesita seguro ni ID. ¡Los esperamos!
outreach.not_selected_message_en: Thank you for your partnership. Your neighborhood had very high need scores and was closely considered for this month's 4 Saturday stops. Because the van has only 4 stops this month, nearby locations were selected. We want to bring the van to your community next. Please contact outreach@fultoncountyga.gov to schedule.
outreach.not_selected_message_es: Gracias por su colaboración. Su comunidad tuvo una alta prioridad en la evaluación de este mes. Debido a que la unidad móvil solo cuenta con 4 paradas este mes, se programaron sitios cercanos. Queremos visitar su vecindario el próximo mes. Escríbanos a outreach@fultoncountyga.gov.
